photos.c: For years Derek Clack has said that in all the time he's been in the club he's not yet had his picture published. Sorry Derek - it's a case of too few photographers required to be in too many places at the right time. However, The Wimbledon Guardian seems to be a little better off in the way of human resource and sent their photographer to snap Derek and Sue after their gruelling hike from John O'Groats to Lands End. The 920 mile walk took our intrepid couple seven weeks but it was well worth it for they raised £1000 for the Tadworth Children's Trust. They got lost for a while at Loch Ness and nearly went over a cliff, got stranded out on the West Highland Way as night fell, suffered from blisters ... makes those training reps up Wool Road seem like a piece of cake!
